title: HCN2 expression restores the neural Vmem prepattern despite nicotine

fields.label: Label
fields.value: HCN2 expression restores the neural Vmem prepattern despite nicotine

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: In nicotine-exposed Xenopus embryos, expression of HCN2 channels enhances the neural-tube-specific hyperpolarization and restores the endogenous Vmem prepattern that nicotine otherwise suppresses, as the BETSE model predicted.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Pai VP 2018, HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns › Results › HCN2 corrects Vmem

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: As predicted, nicotine exposure suppresses the neural brain-specific Vmem pattern, while HCN2 channel expression enhances the neural Vmem pattern and restores it even in presence of the otherwise teratogenic nicotine.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Pai VP, Pietak A, Willocq V, Ye B, Shi NQ, Levin M, “HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns”, Nature communications (2018), doi:10.1038/s41467-018-03334-5; section “Results › HCN2 corrects Vmem”. Scope: Xenopus laevis neurula-stage embryos exposed to nicotine, with or without Hcn2-WT mRNA

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2018-hcn2-09: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.64

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The intervention, readout, and restoration criterion are direct. However, public access to the required raw calibrated images is uncertain, leaving only the reported aggregate evidence and possible related studies.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Quantify calibrated spatial Vmem maps across control, nicotine, HCN2, and combined groups and test whether HCN2 restores the neural-to-lateral voltage contrast suppressed by nicotine.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
No open embryo-level voltage-image dataset is specified.

Injection and imaging batches may confound group differences.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
discriminating power: 0.88
data existence: 0.35
data adequacy: 0.3
analysis feasibility: 0.84
operationalizability: 0.95

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The variables are standard calibrated Vmem maps, so the result is testable in principle. The data-availability statement places those maps in the article figures or with the corresponding author, and re-reading the figure that states the result is not a test. BETSE can recompute the prediction and cannot supply the missing images. An independent imaging series, or a deposited raw stack, is required.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Measure neural-tube versus lateral Vmem in stage-15 embryos across control, nicotine, HCN2, and nicotine plus HCN2. Restoration is confirmed if nicotine flattens the hyperpolarized domain and HCN2 returns it; a still-flat domain after HCN2 would refute it.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Voltage-reporter binding can change with channel overexpression.

No public archive holds the four-condition voltage-dye image set.

Author-on-request files are not an open dataset.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:

operationalizability: 0.86
